text:
deploybot: Deploy check FAILED for release v2026.03.21-rc3 — PAUSED. Reason: env var REGION_CRON mismatch between staging and prod. preflight cron-validate failed.

deploybot: diff (staging vs prod):
```
staging: REGION_CRON='0 02 * * *'
staging: REGION_TZ='UTC'

prod:    REGION_CRON='0 02 * * 1-5'
prod:    REGION_TZ='America/Los_Angeles'
```

olivia: Uh — that TZ + weekday-only cron is a behavior change. Our maintenance job will skip weekends in prod but run daily in staging. Could silently miss runs. :eyes:

jamie: Who documented a cron/timezone change in the release notes or change window? I don't see anything in the changelog or the draft release notes.

kevin: That was my change earlier in canary for cost reasons (reduce weekend runs). I updated a helm values file but I forgot to propagate the staging->prod sync step. My bad.

maria: Two options: 1) revert prod to match staging (fast), 2) pin the release and do a controlled config change in the next change window with notes and rollback plan. I vote revert now to keep parity.

olivia: +1 revert. Prefer revert during low traffic — 03:00 UTC works for us.

deploybot: Action recommended: revert prod config to staging values. Rollback helper: `./scripts/rollback.sh --env prod --set REGION_CRON='0 02 * * *' --set REGION_TZ='UTC'`

kevin: Running revert now. Command I'm using: `kubectl set env deployment/scheduler -n prod REGION_CRON='0 02 * * *' REGION_TZ='UTC'`

kevin: Patch applied. Re-running preflight checks...
`cron-validate: OK`
`config-sync: OK`

maria: Confirmed by monitoring — scheduler heartbeat resumed and weekend job shows as next run 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. I'll update the release notes with a hotfix entry.

olivia: Add a follow-up: add an env parity check to the deploy pipeline (small e2e that compares critical REGION_* vars between envs). Assign to kevin. @sre-oncall FYI for postmortem.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Will add a brief blameless note in the incident notebook.

kevin: Opening PR to add `env-sync` step & a small test for REGION_CRON/TZ. Will target the pipeline next sprint.

maria: Release notes updated: "Hotfix: reverted prod cron/timezone to match staging due to scheduling parity issue; change window planned 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC for controlled update."

deploybot: Release unblocked. Resume promotion for v2026.03.21-rc3 when ready. :thumbsup:
